newsitem.title: USA: Andersen Worldwide names Jim Wadia CEO.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Worldwide names Jim Wadia CEO.

text.p: Consulting and accounting firm Andersen Worldwide said its board of directors recommended Jim Wadia be named the company's next managing partner-chief executive.
The firm said it needed a vote of two-thirds of Andersen Worldwide's approximately 2,700 partners to elect a candidate recommended by the board.
The results of the ballot were expected to be announced during May, it said.
Wadia, 49, has been Managing Partner of Arthur Andersen in the United Kingdom since 1993, it said.

If the nomination was ratified, Wadia would assume the position for a four-year term beginning September 1, replacing Lawrence Weinbach who announced earlier this year that he would not stand for election to a third term and would retire from the firm when his term expired at the end of August.
